blocks.text: The mechanism of action is how a drug works at a cellular level to produce medical effects. Here we shall discuss two famous medicines i.e., aspirin and penicillin along with their mechanism of drug action. The action of aspirine in blocking COX enzyme has already been discussed in Chemistry XI (chapter 3). Here we will discuss mechanism of action of penicillin.
